asuna.evidence: The pinned archive's own LICENSE opens "this game as a whole is released under GPLv3", because it aggregates GPL works. ContentDB labels it CC BY-SA 4.0, which is the corroborating metadata the review policy says cannot stand in for the notice inside the archive. The archive does enumerate every included work with its own licence file, so individual works may still be admitted on their own provenance, through their own upstream package rather than through Asuna.

backroomtest.evidence: Release 36294 root licence explicitly places media under CC-BY-4.0.

craft_and_ruin.evidence: ContentDB and the upstream repository declare GPL-3.0-only media; project policy excludes GPL-derived asset bundles.

darkage.evidence: Archive LICENSE.txt is MIT but does not clearly scope that licence to media; ContentDB declares CC0-1.0. The mismatch is unresolved.

drummyfish.evidence: Release 834 README explicitly declares the texture pack and its incorporated works CC0-1.0.

hand_painted_expanded.evidence: Release 35538 contains the complete CC0-1.0 legal code and identifies the pack as CC0.

lessdirt.evidence: Release 13232 LICENCE.txt provides per-family CC-BY-SA provenance; derivatives must retain the applicable share-alike version.

mesecons.evidence: mesecons/LICENSE.txt: The CC-BY-SA-3.0 license applies to textures and any other content in this project which is not source code.

pixel_imperfection.evidence: Release 35281 includes CC-BY-SA-4.0 legal text and upstream artwork credits.

pmb_core.evidence: Release 38636 root licence explicitly places media under CC-BY-4.0.

polygonia.evidence: ContentDB declares CC-BY-SA-4.0, but release 17862 contains no licence or attribution file; do not redistribute derivatives until archive evidence is resolved.

realism_512.evidence: ContentDB declares EUPL-1.2 media; project policy excludes EUPL-derived asset bundles.

too_many_stones.evidence: too_many_stones/LICENSE.txt explicitly places textures under MIT, copyright JoeEnderman 2022; LGPL code and geode code are separately scoped.

voxelibre.evidence: Release 38585 LEGAL.md is a mixed notice (Pixel Perfection CC-BY-SA-4.0 unless noted, named CC-BY-SA-4.0 works, other files CC-BY-SA-3.0) and mods carry their own notices, so it qualifies per file. tools/pbr_audit_voxelibre.py recorded all 902 authored stems on 2026-10-05: 722 CC-BY-SA-4.0, 132 CC-BY-SA-3.0, 10 CC0-1.0 and 38 GPL-3.0. The GPL-3.0 stems are 7 mcl_fences textures under a 'source code and textures: GNU GPLv3' notice and 31 mcl_flowers textures under an unscoped 'GNU GPLv3' line, read as covering them.
voxelibre.media_license: CC-BY-SA-3.0/4.0, CC0-1.0 and GPL-3.0 per file

draconis.evidence: Release 34129 carries one notice, an MIT LICENSE by ElCeejo, and no credits or media notice naming other authors or terms. ContentDB declares the media MIT, agreeing with it, unlike Darkage, where the archive and ContentDB disagreed. Read on 2026-10-05.

sum_airship.evidence: Release 30601 license.txt opens 'Media contained within is under CC-BY-4.0', by Sumi (SumianVoice), above the MIT code licence. Read on 2026-10-05.

goblins.evidence: Release 32959 README.md licenses the goblin and goblin dog skins (written 'goblins_goblins*.png', which is the goblin skins' own prefix), the models and the mushroom textures CC-BY-SA-3.0 by FreeLikeGNU, and goblins_goblin_king.png CC-BY-SA-3.0 from the SummerFields texture pack. The molten gold (credited to Wikimedia Commons and VanessaE with no licence) and the lightning (openclipart, no licence stated) are excluded, as are icons the notices do not name. The LICENSE file is MIT for code. Read on 2026-10-05.

edit_skin.evidence: Release 30155: README.md puts code under MIT and says media_credits.txt holds the media licensing; that file names an author and licence (CC BY-SA 3.0 or 4.0) per file. The 9 parts it does not name (bottom_1, bottom_2, bottom_6, hair_7, headwear_6, mouth_6, top_3, top_7, top_19) take the media licence the author declares on ContentDB, CC BY-SA 4.0, as nothing in the archive says otherwise. All 68 parts recorded per file on 2026-10-05.

cottages.evidence: Release 22105: LICENSE is GPLv3 for code; README.md lists media per file (CC BY-SA 3.0, WTFPL, CC BY-SA 2.0 DE, and textures renamed from Minetest Game, checked by pixels). 22 node textures are recorded per file on 2026-10-05; stone and wool are recorded CC BY-SA 3.0 as Minetest Game's pixels, not the README's WTFPL. The rope (credited only 'CC') and the dirt road textures the README does not name are excluded. Later the same day: the rope, credited 'Bas080 (CC)', is recorded CC BY-SA 3.0 with attribution under the owner's rule that a bare CC is usable.

basic_materials.evidence: Release 38908: README.md and LICENSE put all media under CC BY-SA 4.0. Read on 2026-10-05.

dfcaverns.evidence: Release 22198 is a modpack whose submods each carry textures/license.txt: FaceDeer's own art CC0 (also MIT), df_primordial_items by ClockGen CC BY 4.0, with per file exceptions derived from Minetest Game, farming, caverealms, moretrees, Nether, Wikimedia and NSF images; bones and fireflies copies are Minetest Game's. 185 node textures are recorded per file on 2026-10-05. Derivatives of Minetest Game textures are recorded CC BY-SA 3.0 and of caverealms WTFPL, the strictest licence each could be under. Excluded: the tunnel tube (from moretrees, unaudited), big webs and subterrane's dripstone (no media notice), the achievement and food icons, and textures named nowhere. ContentDB's MIT media label is wrong for much of the archive. Later the same day: big_webs, which has no notice, is recorded CC BY-SA 3.0, the strictest licence the package's files carry, its MIT label being understated. The tunnel tube, 'derived from moretrees palm tree bark', is More Trees' palm trunk recoloured one for one; with More Trees read, it is recorded CC BY-SA 4.0 after Vanessa Ezekowitz.
dfcaverns.media_license: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-3.0/4.0, CC-BY-SA-3.0 and WTFPL per file

nextgen_fungi.evidence: Release 20073 README.txt: code CC0, media 'StarNinjas (CC BY-SA 3.0)'; its six textures match nothing in Minetest Game. Read on 2026-10-05.

mcl_decor.evidence: Release 35460 README.md: 'The media files are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0'; its credits name the Pixel Perfection sources of each derivative (XSSheep, NovaWostra, SURV), all CC BY-SA 4.0. 12 world textures recorded per file on 2026-10-05. The README names rudzik8 as author; ContentDB lists EmoryNB.

steampunk_blimp.evidence: Release 38331 README.md: 'Blimp model and textures by APercy. CC BY-SA 3.0', with the deed; LICENSE is MIT for code. 13 textures recorded on 2026-10-05.

3d_armor.evidence: Release 37711 LICENSE.md: 'Armor Textures: Copyright (C) 2017-2023 davidthecreator - CC-BY-SA 3.0' and 'New armor/shield textures CC-BY-SA 3.0 / davidthecreator'; no submod has its own notice. 52 worn armour and shield layers recorded on 2026-10-05; the nether set, added by lortas, falls under the same line. The armour stand textures, which no notice names, are excluded. Later the same day: the armour stand's three textures, named by no notice, are recorded under the package's declared CC BY-SA 3.0.

animalia.evidence: Release 34128 carries one notice, an MIT LICENSE by ElCeejo, with no credits naming other authors; ContentDB's MIT media label agrees. 70 creature skins recorded on 2026-10-05.

mobs_animal.evidence: Release 39178 license.txt lists files by author under mixed licences; ContentDB's CC-BY-SA-4.0 label matches no line of it. 19 world textures recorded per file on 2026-10-05 (CC0, WTFPL, CC BY-SA 3.0, MIT). Excluded: the sheep (CC BY-SA 4.0 NC, non-commercial), the rats ('CCPL', no licence named), mobs_bunny_evil, mobs_kitten_black and the beehive (named by no line). Later the same day, under the rule that a file no notice names takes the declared licence: mobs_bunny_evil and mobs_kitten_black are recorded CC BY-SA 4.0. The beehive (24 px, not buildable) is not authored.
mobs_animal.media_license: CC0-1.0, WTFPL, CC-BY-SA-3.0 and MIT per file

mobs_monster.evidence: Release 38244 license.txt lists files by author under mixed licences; ContentDB's CC-BY-3.0 label matches no line of it. 41 world textures recorded per file on 2026-10-05 (WTFPL, CC0, CC BY-SA 3.0 and 4.0, MIT). Excluded, named by no line: dungeon master skin 3, oerkki skins 2 and 3, land guard skins 4 to 8, the fire spirit and the cobweb. Later the same day, under the rule that a file no notice names takes the strictest licence the package's files carry where the declared one is understated: dungeon master 3, oerkki 2 and 3, land guard 4 to 8 and the cobweb are recorded CC BY-SA 4.0. The fire spirit's own texture is fully transparent and is not authored.
mobs_monster.media_license: CC0-1.0, WTFPL, CC-BY-SA-3.0/4.0 and MIT per file

bees.evidence: Release 38367's only media notice is 'Textures by Bas80 and Neuromancer are CC BY-SA', with no version and no file list; the package declares CC-BY-SA-3.0 on ContentDB, which supplies the version and agrees with the notice. Its 7 world textures are recorded CC BY-SA 3.0 with both authors credited on every file, 2026-10-05.

x_farming.evidence: Release 38796 LICENSE.txt ends in per file credits: 576 textures CC BY-SA 4.0 by SaKeL (11 noting a source: Farmer's Delight by vectorwing, MIT; Pixel Perfection by XSSheep; Minetest Game textures by paramat, PilzAdam, Splizard, random-geek, Neuromancer and Calinou, CC BY-SA 3.0), the glass bottle CC BY-SA 3.0 modified by Thomas-S, and a GUI image by BlockMen. README.md and ContentDB agree on CC BY-SA 4.0. 331 world textures recorded per file on 2026-10-05; soil_wet_side, misattributed to SaKeL but byte identical to PilzAdam's, is recorded CC BY-SA 4.0 with PilzAdam credited, and is not authored (faint alpha).

moretrees.evidence: Release 38501 LICENSE: 'License for all media and all other assets: CC-by-SA 4.0', with an author per file: Rogier (date and date palm, cocos flower, green coconuts, poplar), Tim Huppertz (the other saplings), Vanessa Ezekowitz (everything else); ContentDB agrees. Rogier's and Huppertz's textures were first published CC BY-SA 3.0 and relabelled 4.0 in 2018, which BY-SA 3.0 permits for adaptations. 86 world textures recorded on 2026-10-05.
